  • Method Details

    • record

      public void record(TextHistory.State before, boolean typing, long time)
      Record the state before an edit. Consecutive typing at the same position within a short time is grouped into a single undo step.
      Parameters:
      before - The state before the edit.
      typing - If the edit was caused by typing a single character.
      time - The current time in milliseconds.

    • undo

      @Nullable public TextHistory.State undo(TextHistory.State current)
      Parameters:
      current - The current state, which will become redoable.
      Returns:
      The state to restore, or null if there is nothing to undo.
